outcome: survival rate for at least one twin
cohort: Five consecutive patients with monochorionic twin pregnancies diagnosed with at least Quintero Stage II twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) who underwent fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP) at KK Women's and Children's Hospital, Singapore, between June 2011 and March 2014.
finding: Fetoscopic laser photocoagulation (FLP) was found to be a feasible treatment for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) with minimal maternal complications, achieving perinatal survival rates comparable to international centres (overall 60%, double-infant 40%, at least one twin 80%).
gest_age: Initial presentation: 19 (range 17-20) weeks; Laser photocoagulation: 20 (range 19-23) weeks; Delivery: 29 (range 28-34) weeks
